script.changeLog: Pinned the web and torrent ports, gave the chart's Downloads storage the Downloads folder (mounted at /downloads) and set it as the default download folder through qBittorrent's settings on every install (also a card action for an install from before), and moved to the v6 install script format. Existing installs: a torrent from before this update keeps its old /config/Downloads path and shows as missing files until its location is set to the same path under /downloads (right-click, Set location); the files themselves have not moved.

hooks.title: Save downloads to your Downloads folder
hooks.description: Sets qBittorrent's download folder to the Downloads folder on this server, with a subfolder per app that sends it downloads
